alt.en: A teal glass cube with a sphere core sends a dashed orange line carrying small packets through a gray gateway toward a gray server rack at the back. A dark broken line runs from the rack to a stack of gray discs behind it on the right, and a dashed outline of a packet sits in its gap.
alt.zh: 一个青色玻璃立方体发出带数据包的橙色虚线，穿过灰色门框通向后方的灰色服务器机柜。机柜与其右后方一叠灰色圆盘之间的深色连线中断，断口处只有一个虚线勾勒的数据包。

caption.en: Illustration: an agent's turns pass a session cap into a serving engine whose link to its key-value cache is broken, as the preprint describes. It does not depict the authors' engines, GPUs or models, and it does not show a tested deployment or that session caps recover cache reuse.
caption.zh: 示意图：智能体的轮次经由会话数量上限进入服务引擎，而引擎与键值缓存之间的连线已中断，对应预印本描述的情形。图中不代表作者测试的引擎、GPU 或模型，也不表示任何经过测试的部署，更不表示会话数量上限能恢复缓存复用。

scene.note: Agents + runtime story. Agent turns (orange path) pass a neutral gate (session cap) into the serving engine (rack, focal); the engine's link to its KV cache (disc stack, back right) is broken, with a ghost packet in the gap, placed clear of the gate's pillars. No TEE in the story, so no indigo; the one glow is the data path.
